flowing-purity:afterSkill.label: After her Skill
flowing-purity:afterSkill.reason: Its Elemental DMG bonus lasts 15 seconds after her Elemental Skill and can start again every 10, so it is up while she casts her Skill when it is ready.

flowing-purity:bond.label: Bond of Life cleared
flowing-purity:bond.reason: It needs the Bond of Life the weapon gives her to be cleared by healing, which depends on the team.
